label: P1 sweeps intents.near->wallets, since 2025-05-10 (DefiLlama start), no args
sql: SELECT block_date, receipt_receiver_account_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.receipt_actions` WHERE block_date >= DATE '2025-05-10' AND action_kind='TRANSFER' AND receipt_predecessor_account_id='intents.near' AND receipt_receiver_account_id IN ('fefundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near','1csfundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near','buybacks.multisignature.near') GROUP BY 1,2

label: P1w sweeps + args(deposit), since 2025-05-10
sql: SELECT block_date, receipt_receiver_account_id, SUM(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(args,'$.deposit') AS FLOAT64)) AS yocto FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.receipt_actions` WHERE block_date >= DATE '2025-05-10' AND action_kind='TRANSFER' AND receipt_predecessor_account_id='intents.near' AND receipt_receiver_account_id IN ('fefundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near','1csfundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near','buybacks.multisignature.near') GROUP BY 1,2

label: P1w 30d chunk
sql: SELECT block_date, receipt_receiver_account_id, SUM(SAFE_CAST(JSON_VALUE(args,'$.deposit') AS FLOAT64)) AS yocto FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.receipt_actions` WHERE block_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND action_kind='TRANSFER' AND receipt_predecessor_account_id='intents.near' AND receipt_receiver_account_id IN ('fefundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near','1csfundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near','buybacks.multisignature.near') GROUP BY 1,2

label: P2 burn: execution_outcomes SUM(tokens_burnt) daily, since 2025-05-10
sql: SELECT block_date, SUM(tokens_burnt) AS burnt_yocto, SUM(gas_burnt) AS gas FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.execution_outcomes` WHERE block_date >= DATE '2025-05-10' GROUP BY 1

label: P2b burn: transactions.receipt_conversion_tokens_burnt daily, since 2025-05-10
sql: SELECT block_date, SUM(receipt_conversion_tokens_burnt) AS burnt_yocto FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.transactions` WHERE block_date >= DATE '2025-05-10' GROUP BY 1

label: P3 issuance: blocks total_supply daily, since 2025-05-10
sql: SELECT block_date, MAX_BY(total_supply, block_height) AS total_supply FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.blocks` WHERE block_date >= DATE '2025-05-10' GROUP BY 1

label: P4 dev: DEPLOY_CONTRACT receipt_actions, since 2025-05-10
sql: SELECT block_date, receipt_receiver_account_id FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.receipt_actions` WHERE block_date >= DATE '2025-05-10' AND action_kind='DEPLOY_CONTRACT'

label: P5 intents.near FUNCTION_CALL count daily, since 2025-05-10
sql: SELECT block_date, COUNT(*) AS n FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.receipt_actions` WHERE block_date >= DATE '2025-05-10' AND action_kind='FUNCTION_CALL' AND receipt_receiver_account_id='intents.near' GROUP BY 1

label: S1 tokens_burnt unit sanity (1 day)
sql: SELECT block_date, SUM(tokens_burnt) AS burnt_yocto, SUM(gas_burnt) AS gas_burnt FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.execution_outcomes` WHERE block_date = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 2 DAY) GROUP BY 1
